name: TitleCardMaker
description: TitleCardMaker Automated title card maker for Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin. Setup instructions are hosted on GitHub: https://github.com/CollinHeist/TitleCardMaker/wiki/Docker-Tutorial

paths.name: Configuration Path
paths.description: Directory to contain all configuration files

paths.name: Archive Directory
paths.description: Directory to contain archives of title cards

paths.name: Log Directory
paths.description: Directory to contain all log files

paths.name: Tautulli Directory
paths.description: Directory containing the Tautulli update file

variables.name: Runtime
variables.description: Start time for TitleCardMaker's scheduled operation. Container Variable: TCM_RUNTIME / --runtime

variables.name: Run Frequency
variables.description: How often to run TitleCardMaker. Container Variable: TCM_FREQUENCY / --frequency

variables.name: Missing File
variables.description: Container filepath to write all missing assets to. Container Variable: TCM_MISSING / --missing

variables.name: Tautulli Update List
variables.description: Container filepath to monitor for Tautulli integration. Container Variable: TCM_TAUTULLI_UPDATE_LIST / --tautulli-update-list

variables.name: Tautulli Update Frequency
variables.description: How often to check for the Tautulli update file. Container Variable: TCM_TAUTULLI_UPDATE_FREQUENCY / --tautulli-update-frequency

variables.name: Output Log Level
variables.description: Log level for all messages. Container Variable: TCM_LOG / --log
